title: Close concrete MM-07/MM-08/MM-10 implementation gaps
steps: Reconcile the provenance, moderation, Canon, format-legality and governance reference implementations against their specs and negative fixtures.
Select the smallest concrete missing code or test behavior, prioritizing fail-closed trust boundaries.
Implement the selected behavior with versioned contracts and deterministic regression coverage.
Do not implement unrestricted public uploads, automatic Canon promotion or unapproved licensing/policy decisions.
Leave operator, privacy, moderation and public-contact acceptance as explicit external gates.
acceptance: A concrete trust-boundary or governance implementation gap is closed with negative-case evidence and no policy gate is silently promoted to complete.
